points: Built on OAuth; customers grant read-only or write access
Version 0.1 specification promised later in October; no spec to test yet
Payments support is planned, not included
read: Full announcement on Sierra's blog; no Meta post found
take: Another agent protocol, backed by Shopify, Stripe and Walmart. It lets a business identify a customer's agent and limit what it may do.
title: Meta and Sierra propose a standard for customers' AI agents
